tools.name: easymesh_batch_export
tools.description: Export Selected Meshes: Exports selected mesh objects sequentially with status bar progress. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

batch_name.description: Name for the combined batch export file (without extension)

tools.name: easymesh_load_export_preset
tools.description: Load Preset: Load export settings from a saved preset. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

preset_name.description: Name of the preset to load

tools.name: easymesh_clear_export_indicators
tools.description: Clear All Export Indicators: Clears export indicators from all mesh objects. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.
